chalisa.do1: Keeping mind, speech and action in check, I pray with folded hands. Viśvakarmā, foe of the wicked, fulfil my wish.
chalisa.cau1: Viśvakarmā, your name is incomparable: holy, joy-giving and worthy of contemplation. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Your fair fame is in all the fourteen worlds; men and women sing your virtues day after day. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: Sarasvatī, Śeṣa, Śiva and Bhavānī, poets, scholars, those who prize virtue, and the wise, ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: the Āgamas, the Vedas and the great Purāṇas, those beyond the guṇas, the virtuous and the discerning, ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: those in the world who proclaim the highest truth, the upholders of dharma, and the blessed Sanaka and his brothers: ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: all these sing your virtues and glory day after day. Blessed, blessed are you, my Viśvakarmā. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: At the beginning of creation you, the imperishable, left the abode of liberation and came gladly. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: The first auspicious path in the world is yours; the fame of your art is in the fourteen worlds. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: When you became Āditya, a celibate student, you then became a sage who had mastered the Vedas. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: You were learned in philosophy and the Purāṇas, and well versed in the famed arts and in history. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: You were called the first Viśvakarmā, and you spread the fourteen sciences over the earth. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: Iron, wood, copper and gold, and the craft of stone: these, the five classes of craft, ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: teaching these, you destroyed sorrow and poverty and made happiness and prosperity shine in the world. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: The sages Sanaka and his brothers are your disciples; Brahmā and the others called out: Victory to you, lord of sages. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: For this reason you became the teacher of the world; you struck down the whole mass of darkness and ignorance. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: Your excellent virtues are divine and wondrous; you destroy obstacles and remove fear. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: To bring about creation, your name became Brahmā Viśvakarmā, and you took it on. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: Like the wondrous Viṣṇu, you are the protector of the world; as Śiva you are the giver of welfare, wholly beyond compare. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: Salutations, salutations to you, divine Viśvakarmā. Through service to you, O god, wishes are easily won. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: Gods, demons, kinnaras and gandharvas all bow at your two feet. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: One in whose heart unwavering devotion to you dwells holds the four goals of life in the palm of his hand. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: The fourteen worlds serve you; your holy feet bring the world into being. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Viśvakarmā is the god of gods; through service to him a wondrous fruit is easily won. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: He is a storehouse of worldly renown and art, and its giver; his fame spreads through the three worlds. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: Taking a body as Viśvakarmā, son of Bhuvana, you reflected on the essence of the Atharvaveda. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: All the work of the Atharvaveda and the Śilpaśāstra, and of the Dhanurveda, is yours. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: Whenever great calamity fell on the gods, you, Lord, ended their distress by putting your art to use. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: Viṣṇu's discus, Brahmā's water-pot and Rudra's trident: all these you made, and the whole globe of the earth. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: Indra's bow and the bow Pināka, and the aerial car Puṣpaka with its wondrous wheels, you made as well. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: You made aircraft along with flying couches, and opened up the art of electricity and every system. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: The sun, the moon, the nine planets and the guardians of the quarters, this world and the worlds beyond, the sky and the netherworld, ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: fire, air, earth, water and space: all these inventions you brought to light. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: Manu, Maya, Tvaṣṭā, the great Śilpī and the sage Devāgama became well versed in this path. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: The fine work in iron, wood, stone and copper, together with the goldsmith's, makes the fivefold calling. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Śiva, Dadhīci and King Hariścandra all kept your teaching in the Kṛta age. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: The wise Paraśurāma, Nala and Nīla, Rāvaṇa and Śrī Rāma: in the Tretā age all of them were your disciples. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: In the Dvāpara age Droṇācārya joyfully brought lustre to the line of Viśvakarmā. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Yudhiṣṭhira received the work of Maya's craft, and in his mind meditated on Viśvakarmā's feet. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: You drew magical designs of many kinds; the sight of King Vikrama's figurines is beyond description. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: All your virtues are beyond description, beyond words. Salutations, salutations to you, remover of fear. ॥40॥
chalisa.do2: The Lord is divine light, a divine portion, the light of divine knowledge; with divine sight through all three times, Viśvakarmā shines in radiance.
chalisa.do3: I pray with both hands joined that I may hold your holy fame in my heart and keep dwelling on it, and that your grace may pour forth.
chalisa.cha1: Whoever reads and hears this with love, dispassion and faith, and with trust reflects and ponders on the chaupāīs of the Chālīsā, Lord Viśvakarmā will keep him far from the snare of worldly existence and from obstacles; crushing hardship and calamity, he will surely give him the joy of liberation.
